Market today: The market is in a panic, driven by a deep AI/tech sell-off, with Nvidia and Qualcomm leading the plunge. This directly hits your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Your portfolio is flashing red, with almost everything on "SELL" status. Leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-81.82%) and MUU (-66.07%) are in dire straits, amplifying losses on margin. Even CRWD, while profitable, got caught in the cybersecurity rout.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader tech sentiment, especially any further news on Nvidia's congressional briefing. Also, watch for potential bounces or further capitulation signals.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management and stop-loss adherence, especially on your deeply negative leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your 3x leveraged chip ETF is down -81.82%. Review its stop (currently 200, but price is 40.87) and consider trimming or exiting to manage extreme margin risk.
MUU: This 2x leveraged MU ETF is down -66.07%. Its stop is 31.6, price 12.62. Re-evaluate this position and its stop to prevent further deep losses.
SQQQ: Consider a small hedge with SQQQ (inverse Nasdaq 3x) given the tech sell-off. Scanner entry 48.09-47.93, stop 47.45.
